stored_path_consistency.scope: numerical endpoint/path consistency of smooth finite-bank surrogate; not a physics or ranking certificate

interpretation.primary: Historical local wind almost completely identifies one exogenous bank atom. The same atom dominates both source endpoints and midpoint before and after the future block, so mixture-before-log, expected-log, and privileged-single-atom targets numerically coincide.
interpretation.implementation_check: All six serialized target labels are recomputed independently from the matching frozen checkpoint. Coincidence is explained by responsibility concentration, not evidence that the three algebraic target implementations are accidentally aliased.
interpretation.path_check: Small endpoint/path defect confirms integration consistency only. A min ESS of one signals no effective nuisance mixing in this target set.
interpretation.scientific_consequence: This engineering matrix is not diagnostic of the independent benefit of source-conditioned projection: its target ablations are almost identical treatments.
interpretation.negative_result_retained: The observed development deterioration versus NLL is a real negative result for this frozen toy experiment. Degeneracy does not erase it, prove that projection works elsewhere, or identify the sole cause of student generalization failure.
interpretation.no_post_result_tuning: No replacement data, changed teacher, retraining, retuned objective, or revised evaluation set is produced by this audit.
